entries.text_de:
Cambridge Corpus Christi College 146, hinter einem Pontifical für Worcester um 11006, im letzten Theile, einem Benedictional aus Winchester um 1025—50:

p. 138 Krönungsliturgie7, sammt Sacr cor, u. S. 2158.

p. 301 Iud Dei I—III, u. S. 401.

Letztes Blatt Excom. IV. V, u. S. 435. Copirt in Vs.
entries.text_en:
Cambridge Corpus Christi College 146: after a pontifical for Worcester of c. 11006, in the last part, a benedictional from Winchester of c. 1025—50:

p. 138 coronation liturgy7, together with Sacr cor, below, p. 2158.

p. 301 Iud Dei I—III, below, p. 401.

Last leaf: Excom. IV. V, below, p. 435. Copied in Vs.

notes.text_de: ed. hieraus L. G. W. Legg Coronation records p. 12.
notes.text_en: edited from this by L. G. W. Legg, Coronation records p. 12.

transcription.doubts: The entry continues at the top of the right column of p. xxi (p. 301 …). Small capitals in n. 6 given in lower case.
